#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/lhl/hipEngine
LOG=/tmp/hipengine-paro-refresh-20261031
MODEL=/tmp/paro-correctness-current/model
mkdir -p "$LOG"
base=(scripts/qwen35_readme_sweep.py --engine paro --model "$MODEL" --backend hip_gfx1100 --shared-expert-format packed_paro_w4 --token-id 9707 --compiler-version-file /tmp/hipengine-paro-verifier-20261024/hipcc-version.txt --attn-aotriton-min-tokens 512 --graph-replay-decode)
echo '[prebuild] PARO 512/1'
bash /tmp/paro-verifier-run.sh run "${base[@]}" --workloads 512/1 --warmup-runs 0 --measured-runs 1 --warmup-decode-tokens 4 --json "$LOG/prebuild.json" > "$LOG/prebuild.log" 2>&1
components=()
for workload in 512/128 1K/128 4K/128 32K/128 64K/128 128K/128; do
  safe=${workload//\//-}
  echo "[measure] PARO $workload"
  bash /tmp/paro-verifier-run.sh run "${base[@]}" --workloads "$workload" --warmup-runs 2 --measured-runs 5 --warmup-decode-tokens 4 --require-cached-build --json "$LOG/paro-$safe.json" > "$LOG/paro-$safe.log" 2>&1
  components+=("$LOG/paro-$safe.json")
  echo "[complete] PARO $workload"
done
uv run python scripts/merge_readme_sweep_components.py --platform gfx1100 --engine paro --components "${components[@]}" --json "$LOG/paro-sweep.json" > "$LOG/merge.log" 2>&1
echo '[complete] PARO six-shape sweep'
echo '[measure] Public true AR / MTP full category suite, three counterbalanced repeats'
bash /tmp/paro-verifier-run.sh run scripts/specdec2_perf_gfx1100_child.py --model "$MODEL" --profile production --candidate-budget 1 --prompts benchmarks/prompts/mtpbench-code-general-ja.jsonl --runs 3 --max-tokens 25 --warmup --max-sequence-length 1024 --compiler-version-file /tmp/hipengine-paro-verifier-20261024/hipcc-version.txt --output "$LOG/public-api.json" > "$LOG/public-api.log" 2>&1
echo '[complete] Public AR/MTP category measurement'
for prompt in code_merge_intervals code_topological_sort code_lru_cache code_markdown_table general_en_plan general_en_explain general_ja_plan general_ja_explain mixed_ja_en_translate mixed_ja_en_review; do
  echo "[numerics] $prompt"
  bash /tmp/paro-verifier-run.sh run scripts/mtp_paro_verifier_numerics.py --model "$MODEL" --prompts-file benchmarks/prompts/mtpbench-code-general-ja.jsonl --prompt-name "$prompt" --prompt-render raw --decode-tokens 24 --out "$LOG/numerics-$prompt.json" > "$LOG/numerics-$prompt.log" 2>&1
done
echo '[complete] PARO benchmark refresh'

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/lhl/hipEngine
bash /tmp/paro-verifier-run.sh run scripts/specdec2_perf_gfx1100_child.py --model /tmp/paro-correctness-current/model --profile production --candidate-budget 1 --prompts benchmarks/prompts/mtpbench-code-general-ja.jsonl --runs 3 --max-tokens 25 --warmup --max-sequence-length 1024 --compiler-version-file /tmp/hipengine-paro-verifier-20261024/hipcc-version.txt --output /tmp/hipengine-paro-refresh-20261031/public-api.json > /tmp/hipengine-paro-refresh-20261031/public-api.log 2>&1

"""Assemble the committed October 31 PARO refresh without changing source reports."""
from collections import defaultdict
from copy import deepcopy
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path('/home/lhl/hipEngine')
RAW = Path('/tmp/hipengine-paro-refresh-20261031')
OUT = RAW / 'publish'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
NAMES = [json.loads(line)['id'] for line in (ROOT / 'benchmarks/prompts/mtpbench-code-general-ja.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]

def load(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text())

def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def save(name, data):
    (OUT / name).write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) + '\n')

def slim_memory(value):
    out = {key: item for key, item in value.items() if isinstance(item, (int, float, str, bool)) or item is None}
    if isinstance(value.get('kv_memory_audit'), dict):
        out['kv_memory_audit'] = {key: item for key, item in value['kv_memory_audit'].items() if isinstance(item, (int, float, str, bool)) or item is None}
    return out

scripts = [Path('/tmp/hipengine-paro-refresh-20261031.sh'), Path('/tmp/paro-verifier-run.sh'), Path('/tmp/paro-public-budget-repair-20261031.sh'), Path(__file__)]
recipe = {'launch_command': ['bash', str(scripts[0])], 'launcher_sources': [{'path': str(path), 'sha256': digest(path), 'source': path.read_text()} for path in scripts], 'compiler_version': Path('/tmp/hipengine-paro-verifier-20261024/hipcc-version.txt').read_text(), 'environment_reset': 'env -i; full explicit environment is preserved in launcher_source', 'profiler': {'enabled': False}, 'scratch_policy': 'runtime default, not overridden', 'protocol': 'worklog/entries/20261031T182654.783128Z-lhl-paro-readme-refresh-protocol-7b46f7.md'}
hardware = {'host': 'epyc', 'gpu': 'AMD Radeon Pro W7900', 'arch': 'gfx1100', 'device_serial': 'D7070100', 'hip_visible_devices': '0', 'hip_runtime_version': 71500000}

sweep = load(RAW / 'paro-sweep.json')
assert sweep['status'] == 'accepted_topline' and all(sweep['correctness'].values())
assert sweep['warmup_runs'] == 2 and sweep['measured_runs'] == 5
assert set(sweep['summary_by_workload']) == {'512/128', '1K/128', '4K/128', '32K/128', '64K/128', '128K/128'}
for shape, runs in sweep['runs_by_workload'].items():
    measured = [run for run in runs if run['measured']]
    assert len(runs) == 7 and len(measured) == 5
    summary = sweep['summary_by_workload'][shape]
    for metric in ['prefill_tok_s', 'decode_tok_s']:
        values = [run['throughput'][metric] for run in measured]
        assert all(math.isfinite(value) and value > 0 for value in values)
        assert math.isclose(summary[metric]['median'], statistics.median(values), rel_tol=1e-12)
    for run in runs:
        run.pop('memory_snapshots', None)
        run['memory'] = slim_memory(run['memory'])
for shape, mem in sweep['persistent_session_memory_by_workload'].items():
    sweep['persistent_session_memory_by_workload'][shape] = slim_memory(mem)
sweep.update(date_utc='2026-10-31', hardware_identity=hardware, reproduction=recipe)
sweep['notes'].append('Dated source refresh, not an isolated optimization A/B. Verbose memory inventories omitted; timing samples, summaries, sanity checks, allocator high-water and component provenance preserved.')
save('2026-10-31-w7900-paro-packed-5run.json', sweep)

public = load(RAW / 'public-api.json')
assert public['status'] == 'complete' and public['runs'] == 3
assert set(public['prompt_ids']) == set(NAMES)
assert len(public['rows']) == 60 and public['max_tokens'] == 25
assert not any(public['provenance'][name] for name in ['staged_dirty', 'unstaged_dirty', 'untracked_dirty'])
by_case = defaultdict(dict)
by_prompt_arm = defaultdict(list)
rows = []
for source in public['rows']:
    row = deepcopy(source)
    assert len(row['generated_token_ids']) == 25
    assert row['timing']['timing_owner'] and row['timing']['timing_scope'] == 'request'
    for window in ['decode_only_seconds', 'complete_request_seconds']:
        assert math.isfinite(row['timing'][window]) and row['timing'][window] > 0
    meta = row['route_metadata']
    assert meta['specdec2_mtp2_used'] == (row['arm'] == 'staged')
    if row['arm'] == 'staged':
        n = meta['specdec2_mtp2_candidate_counts']
        a = meta['specdec2_mtp2_accepted_counts']
        assert len(n) == len(a) == meta['specdec2_mtp2_cycles'] > 0
        assert all(0 <= accepted <= candidates == 1 for accepted, candidates in zip(a, n))
        row['acceptance_accounting'] = {'drafted': sum(n), 'accepted': sum(a), 'target_root_rows': len(n), 'generated_after_prefill': 24, 'unaccounted_serial_tail': 24 - len(n) - sum(a)}
        assert row['acceptance_accounting']['unaccounted_serial_tail'] in (0, 1)
    row['route_metadata'] = {key: value for key, value in meta.items() if key != 'scheduler_chunks'}
    # Scheduler summaries and all stage timing samples remain; only repeated
    # per-token text/telemetry and generated marker names are omitted.
    row['stage_ledger'].pop('marker_names', None)
    by_case[(row['prompt_id'], row['run_index'])][row['arm']] = row
    by_prompt_arm[(row['prompt_id'], row['arm'])].append(row)
    rows.append(row)
assert len(by_case) == 30 and all(set(case) == {'true_ar', 'staged'} for case in by_case.values())
repeat = {f'{name}:{arm}': all(row['generated_token_ids'] == values[0]['generated_token_ids'] for row in values) for (name, arm), values in by_prompt_arm.items()}
matched = {f'{name}:run{run}': case['true_ar']['generated_token_ids'] == case['staged']['generated_token_ids'] for (name, run), case in by_case.items()}

def observed_rates(selected):
    result = {}
    for arm in ['true_ar', 'staged']:
        sample = [row for row in selected if row['arm'] == arm]
        transitions = sum(len(row['generated_token_ids']) - 1 for row in sample)
        decode = sum(row['timing']['decode_only_seconds'] for row in sample)
        complete = sum(row['timing']['complete_request_seconds'] for row in sample)
        result[arm] = {'requests': len(sample), 'generated_tokens': transitions + len(sample), 'decode_transitions': transitions, 'decode_only_seconds': decode, 'decode_transition_tok_s': transitions / decode, 'complete_request_seconds': complete, 'complete_output_tok_s': (transitions + len(sample)) / complete}
    result['mtp_over_true_ar_decode_rate'] = result['staged']['decode_transition_tok_s'] / result['true_ar']['decode_transition_tok_s']
    staged = [row['acceptance_accounting'] for row in selected if row['arm'] == 'staged']
    drafted = sum(value['drafted'] for value in staged)
    accepted = sum(value['accepted'] for value in staged)
    result['acceptance'] = {'accepted': accepted, 'drafted': drafted, 'fraction': accepted / drafted}
    return result

numeric = []
for name in NAMES:
    path = RAW / f'numerics-{name}.json'
    data = load(path)
    assert data['status'] == 'inconclusive'
    assert data['performance_claim'] is False
    numeric.append({'prompt_id': name, 'source_sha256': digest(path), 'report': data})
all_numeric_rows = [row for case in numeric for row in case['report']['rows']]
numeric_summary = {'rows': len(all_numeric_rows), 'top1_matches': sum(row['top1_equal'] for row in all_numeric_rows), 'mean_kl': statistics.mean(row['kl'] for row in all_numeric_rows), 'max_kl': max(row['kl'] for row in all_numeric_rows), 'scope': 'pooled sample observations only; no aggregate quality verdict', 'all_execution_failure_lists_empty': all(not case['report']['execution_failures'] for case in numeric), 'current_sample_exceedances': {case['prompt_id']: case['report']['envelopes']['current_sparse_moe_policy']['sample_limits_exceeded'] for case in numeric}, 'historical_sample_exceedances': {case['prompt_id']: case['report']['envelopes']['legacy_mean_tail_kl_envelope']['sample_limits_exceeded'] for case in numeric}}
unpinned_path = RAW / 'public-api-unpinned-default-b2.json'
unpinned = load(unpinned_path)
unpinned_summary = {'source_sha256': digest(unpinned_path), 'provenance': unpinned['provenance'], 'performance_claim': False, 'reason': 'Not accepted as the preregistered B1 comparison: constructor omitted the requested budget, so native default B2 ran while row headers declared B1/c2. Preserved as attribution-error evidence, not a B1 speed result.', 'fix_commit': '2b5d1c765', 'observed_candidate_counts': sorted({count for row in unpinned['rows'] for count in row['route_metadata']['specdec2_mtp2_candidate_counts']}), 'rows': [{key: row[key] for key in ['prompt_id', 'run_index', 'arm', 'candidate_budget', 'realized_candidate_budget', 'generated_token_ids', 'route']} | {'observed_candidate_counts': row['route_metadata']['specdec2_mtp2_candidate_counts'], 'observed_accepted_counts': row['route_metadata']['specdec2_mtp2_accepted_counts']} for row in unpinned['rows']]}
report = {'schema': 1, 'kind': 'w7900_paro_public_mtp_refresh', 'date_utc': '2026-10-31', 'status': 'observed', 'performance_claim': False, 'numerical_policy_verdict': 'inconclusive', 'hardware_identity': hardware, 'model_identity': {'name': 'Qwen3.6-35B-A3B packed PARO W4 + BF16 MTP', 'model_fingerprint': sweep['provenance']['model_fingerprint'], 'kv_dtype': 'bf16', 'weights_target': str((Path(public['model']) / 'model.safetensors').resolve()), 'mtp_target': str((Path(public['model']) / 'mtp-bf16.safetensors').resolve()), 'config_sha256': digest(Path(public['model']) / 'config.json'), 'hash_scope': 'Directory-manifest fingerprint samples the large model files; it is not a full-weight byte hash.'}, 'reproduction': recipe, 'public_source': {'path': str(RAW / 'public-api.json'), 'sha256': digest(RAW / 'public-api.json')}, 'public_capture': {key: value for key, value in public.items() if key != 'rows'}, 'timing_protocol': {'scope': 'instrumented public generation; not the prior low-level persistent-device economics harness', 'decode': 'sum generated IDs minus one first-prefill output per request / sum owned decode_only_seconds', 'complete': 'sum generated IDs / sum measured public call walls; includes load/prepare/tokenization/request work where owned by that call', 'warmup': 'one public AR and MTP warmup, at most eight outputs, before installing stage ledger', 'prompt_render': 'raw', 'runs': 3, 'outputs': 25, 'profile': 'production', 'budget': 1}, 'observed_rates': observed_rates(rows), 'by_category': {category: observed_rates([row for row in rows if row['category'] == category]) for category in sorted({row['category'] for row in rows})}, 'checks': {'all_60_requests_have_25_outputs': True, 'all_30_mtp_requests_engaged': True, 'all_same_arm_repeats_equal': all(repeat.values()), 'all_paired_ar_mtp_ids_equal': all(matched.values()), 'all_acceptance_accounting_consistent': True}, 'same_arm_repeatability': repeat, 'paired_output_equality': matched, 'rows': rows, 'numerical_observations': numeric, 'numerical_summary': numeric_summary, 'discarded_unpinned_capture': unpinned_summary, 'related_correctness_evidence': 'benchmarks/results/2026-10-31-w7900-paro-crossed-state-diagnostic.json', 'limits': ['Public child explicitly marks speed_claim_eligible=false and performance_claim=false. Preserve that scope rather than promote it as a passing MTP headline.', 'The per-prompt numerical tool reports sample observations, not a full production sparse-MoE policy decision or quality certification.', 'Public paired IDs and throughput are separate observations. Production is not required to match strict greedy text.']}
save('2026-10-31-w7900-paro-public-mtp-refresh.json', report)
print(json.dumps({'ar': sweep['summary_by_workload'], 'public': report['observed_rates'], 'checks': report['checks']}, indent=2))
print('Saved', [path.name for path in OUT.iterdir()])
